messages:
Alex: alerting — prod kvc-pool-7 showing a sustained paging/cpu/mem pressure event since ~01:07 UTC. continuous-batching queue depth ramped, streaming frontends reporting token cadence stalls and partial_flush spikes. tagging on-call.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected: INC-2387654321. symptoms: kv_eviction_pressure=0.92, batch_queue_len>4k, stream_partial_flush_rate up 250%. PagerDuty routed to SRE.

Jordan-SRE: I'm on it. starting live metrics scrape for kvc-pool-7 and stream-proxy cluster. pulling recent infra rollouts.

Priya-EngRuntime: any recent changes to batching/kv heuristics? I see a config roll at 00:58 that bumped batch_size_bytes -> 600k and relaxed bloom thresholds.

Eli-Infra: that was an infra/auto-roll change. canary passed quick synthetic checks at rollout time.

Jordan-SRE: digging into logs — eviction loops scanning a lot but evicted=0, cache keeps growing. continuous batching is forming bigger batches (due to higher batch_size) and KV scans per batch spike. stream send path starts doing partial flushes when KV latency crosses threshold. sample logs:
```
[2026-05-02T01:09:13Z] evict.scan: scanned=1.2M evicted=0 mem=90% target=72% pressure=0.92
[2026-05-02T01:09:14Z] batch.dispatch: queued=5120 continuous=true size_bytes=612000
[2026-05-02T01:09:15Z] stream.send: partial_flush=true token_gap=12ms
```

Alex: customer impact — intermittent token drops and chat truncation for a subset of streaming sessions (~1.8% of traffic). CS teams may be receiving tickets. Liz, can you triage affected accounts and surface urgent ones?

Liz-CustomerSuccess: pinged top 6 enterprise accounts showing errors. one account reports repeated truncation on long chat sessions. marking INC-2387654321-CUST to track.

Jordan-SRE: mitigation proposal (immediate): 1) roll back batch_size_bytes to previous 256k 2) enable eviction_boost (force more aggressive reclaim) 3) flip a runtime guard to disable continuous batching when cache_pressure > 0.8 4) route a portion of traffic off affected nodes. apply sequentially and watch.

Priya-EngRuntime: preparing hotfix PR to revert config and add guardrail. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/infra/pull/4321-hotfix-evict-2387

deploy-bot: starting config rollback: infra-config revert batch_size_bytes on kvc-pool-7 -> 256k. Canary: 2 nodes (kvc-7-1,kvc-7-2).

Jordan-SRE: canary node metrics look better after rollback — eviction_pressure down to 0.68, batch_queue_len down ~55%.

Eli-Infra: pre-warming eviction threads and bumping container reclaim hints (vfs_cache_pressure) on the rest of pool. also temporarily lowered autoscale threshold to add capacity if needed.

Priya-EngRuntime: merged guard that disables continuous batching when cache_pressure > 0.8. snippet:
```
if (kv_cache.pressure() > 0.8) {
  batching.continuous_enabled = false;
}
```
Rolling to pool.

Alex: patch rolled, ETA full rollout 01:25 UTC.

Jordan-SRE: after rollout, observed stream token cadence stabilized to 2ms median, partial_flush events dropped close to baseline. queue depth normalized on ~85% of nodes. one host still noisy.

Eli-Infra: manual intervention on host kvc-7-4 — restarted inference-worker to clear stuck eviction loop and reclaimed backlog.
Command: 
```
sudo systemctl restart inference-worker.service && journalctl -u inference-worker -n 200 | grep Evict
```

Jordan-SRE: added temporary routing split to avoid sending new sessions to kvc-7-4 until healthy.

Liz-CustomerSuccess: customer comms sent: quick note describing mitigation, request to validate on their side. tracking window 24h for confirmation. will escalate if customers see further truncation.

monitor-bot: alert suppression in place for 30m to avoid noisy paging alerts during mitigation window.

deploy-bot: full rollout completed at 01:23 UTC. all nodes report config reverted and guard enabled.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled — Jordan-SRE -> Eli-Infra for overnight monitoring at 01:30 UTC. Incident status: mitigated, monitoring in progress.

Alex: postmortem action items: - merge guard into stable branches (Priya) - add unit/integration tests simulating high eviction pressure with continuous batching (EngRuntime) - tighten rollout verification for batch_size_bytes changes (Infra) - reach out to impacted customers with RCA draft & ETA (Liz)

Priya-EngRuntime: creating postmortem draft INC-2387654321-PM with timeline, RCA: config bump + eviction heuristic regression caused cache blowout that amplified batch sizes, increasing KV scan latency and triggering partial flushes in streaming path. assigning owners.

Eli-Infra: I'll monitor dashboards for 6 hours, keep autoscale and routing split ready. will escalate back to SRE if any reoccurrence. marking channel when stable. :white_check_mark:

Jordan-SRE: final note — root cause = simultaneous batch_size increase + a subtle bloom-threshold regression. effective mitigation = config rollback + eviction boost + batching guard + routing split. more durable fixes: improve eviction efficacy and add preflight for config changes that touch batching heuristics.

Alex: thanks team. leaving handoff to Eli. add any spare debugging logs or traces to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
